matching_criterion_description: Classic complete agyria or anterior-dominant lissencephaly has never been documented in isolated YWHAZ probands. Its presence argues decisively against Popov-Chang syndrome and points toward PAFAH1B1, YWHAE, or 17p13.3 microdeletions.

Major terminal transverse or longitudinal limb reduction defects (e.g., phocomelia, ectrodactyly, amelia) are absent across reported Popov-Chang syndrome cohorts. Their presence indicates alternative syndromic diagnoses.
